description:
Approved macro series observations

Return deterministic observations for one approved macro series. Arbitrary user-supplied FRED series codes are not supported.

as_of_date.description: Optional as-of date for PIT historical values.

from_date.description: Inclusive start date for the observation window.

series_code.description: Approved macro series code, as listed by GET /v1/fundamentals/macro/series.

to_date.description: Inclusive end date for the observation window.

name: fundamentals_macro_series_get
